detections.summary: Sponsor read describes Nordlite electrolyte mix, its electrolyte content and its comparison to sports drinks.

detections.evidence_quote: go to nordlite dot com slash pod and use the code pod20 for 20 percent off your first order
detections.summary: Sponsor read includes a discount code and product promotion.

detections.evidence_quote: i noticed i stopped getting that mid afternoon crash pretty much the first week i started using it
detections.summary: Host offers personal experience as support for the product.

product_mentions.evidence_quote: you'll have to bring a cooler of nordlite for the drive honestly

verification_candidates.claim_text: Nordlite's electrolyte ratio is supposedly closer to what the body loses when it sweats.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: sodium potassium and magnesium in a ratio that's supposedly closer to what your body actually loses when you sweat
verification_candidates.rationale: The product's electrolyte composition and claimed resemblance to sweat losses can be checked against the label and typical sweat composition.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Nordlite has three times the electrolytes of a typical sports drink.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: it says right on the packet that it has three times the electrolytes of a typical sports drink
verification_candidates.rationale: The claim is a specific, checkable product comparison used to sell the drink.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Nordlite is not loaded up with sugar like a lot of the other drink mixes on the shelf.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: they also don't load it up with sugar like a lot of the other drink mixes on the shelf
verification_candidates.rationale: The product's sugar content relative to other drink mixes can be checked.
